career_ladder.note: The Junior Hindi Translator Examination recruits linguistic specialists (Junior Translation Officer / Senior Translation Officer) for the Central Secretariat Official Language Service (CSOLS), Ministry of Defence, Ministry of Railways, and other Central Government Ministries and subordinate offices. Translators ensure compliance with official language policies, advancing to administrative directorships in the Official Language cadre.

exam_scheme.note: Selection is conducted in two progressive stages: Paper I (Computer-Based Objective Examination, 200 marks, 120 minutes) testing General Hindi and General English proficiency; and Paper II (Descriptive Translation and Essay Paper, 200 marks, 120 minutes). Final ranking is determined by aggregate performance across Paper I and Paper II (400 marks total) followed by Document Verification.

stages.source_label: SSC — Scheme of Examination for Junior Hindi Translator (Paper I)

papers.paper_name: General Hindi (100 objective multiple choice questions covering grammatical knowledge, usage, vocabulary, synonyms, antonyms, sentence correction)
papers.qualifying_threshold: UR: 30%, OBC/EWS: 25%, SC/ST: 20% (merit cut-off for Paper II)

papers.paper_name: General English (100 objective multiple choice questions covering correct use of words, phrases, idioms, comprehension passages, and grammatical accuracy)
papers.qualifying_threshold: UR: 30%, OBC/EWS: 25%, SC/ST: 20% (merit cut-off for Paper II)

stages.stage_name: Stage 2: Paper II (Descriptive Examination — Translation & Essay)
stages.source_label: SSC — Scheme of Examination for Junior Hindi Translator (Paper II)

papers.paper_name: Translation: One passage from Hindi to English (50 marks) and one passage from English to Hindi (50 marks)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Combined aggregate merit with Paper I

papers.paper_name: Essay: One Essay in Hindi (50 marks) and one Essay in English (50 marks)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Combined aggregate merit with Paper I

financial_package.note: Junior Translation Officer / Junior Hindi Translator posts are placed in Pay Level 6 (₹35,400 – ₹1,12,400), while Senior Translation Officers are placed in Pay Level 7 (₹44,900 – ₹1,42,400) under the 7th Central Pay Commission. The majority of positions are stationed in Central Ministry headquarters in New Delhi and state capital directorates.
financial_package.pay_source_label: 7th CPC Pay Matrix, Table 5 (Civilian Employees), Government of India
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 6 basic pay of ₹35,400 with 58% DA (₹20,532), HRA (10% to 30% depending on city classification X/Y/Z), Transport Allowance (₹1,800 to ₹3,600 + DA on TA), and deducting 10% NPS contribution.

Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) dispensary and empanelled hospital medical facilities

Children Education Allowance (CEA) and Annual Leave Travel Concession (LTC)
